answer: An auditor observes that admission can be priced in elapsed time, not tokens. Each identity extends a hash chain, one link per fixed interval, each link hashing the prior one with the epoch seed. That chain is a mirror of the applicant's past; it cannot be bought without earlier links. Depth is sequential: five hundred sable accounts need five hundred times the wall clock. Every tenth link burns a small ember of escrowed stake, refunded only if a checkpoint matches the published mirror. Bursty clusters finish late and stay unregistered.
